title: Smiling Women Pitching Down: Auditing Representational and Presentational Gender Biases in Image Generative AI
reasoning: The paper examines representational and presentational gender biases in AI-generated imagery by benchmarking against labor statistics and search engine data. While it includes discussions on 'ethical implications' and utilizes 'feminist epistemology' as a theoretical lens, it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or specific moral frameworks as a primary component of its methodology.
